title: Scenario:
prompt: **Scenario:** Your training loss refuses to go down at all from initialization. How do you debug this? (Recall Andrej Karpathy's recipe: try to overfit a single batch of 2 examples; check if `optimizer.zero_grad()` is missing or misplaced; check if labels are accidentally shuffled; check if learning rate is 0 or 100; check if weights are frozen).
